chars.ACHRAF: ACHRAF: a teenage boy wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans, white sneakers and a black school backpack.
chars.IMANE: IMANE: a young teenage girl wearing a lilac long-sleeve pyjama top with small white stars, grey loose trousers and pink slippers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a traditional Moroccan family house living room in Fes with zellige tiles and long Moroccan sofas. ACHRAF has just walked in the front door with his backpack, stopping in shock; IMANE sits hunched on the sofa, pale and frightened, hugging her knees and avoiding his eyes. Tense afternoon light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room. ACHRAF sits down next to IMANE on the sofa, leaning toward her, worried; IMANE turns her face away, scared, clutching a cushion.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: IMANE sits alone on the floor by a window of a traditional Moroccan house, isolated and sad, staring outside, small and lonely in the room. Dim muted colors.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Warm memory: ACHRAF sits on a Moroccan sofa and IMANE hugs his arm and falls asleep leaning on his shoulder; he looks at her protectively. Soft warm lamp light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in the Moroccan living room: IMANE's mitten hands tremble in her lap, her eyes wide with fear; ACHRAF watches her, frowning, realizing something is very wrong.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: ACHRAF kneels in front of IMANE on the sofa, asking her gently with open hands; IMANE shakes her head silently, lips pressed, tears in her eyes.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: ACHRAF stands up and walks toward the tiled staircase of the traditional Moroccan house that leads to the upper floor, pointing upstairs; IMANE on the sofa looks up at him in panic.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At the bottom of the tiled staircase of a Moroccan house, IMANE grabs ACHRAF's arm with both hands, screaming in terror, pulling him back; ACHRAF turns, shocked. Upstairs a closed wooden door is in shadow.
